CHIEF COMPLAINT: Mild fatigue for 1 week.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS: 38-year-old reports feeling more tired than usual over the past week, no other complaints. Sleep and appetite unchanged.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS: Positive for fatigue only. Negative for fever, weight change, chest pain.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY: No chronic conditions.

VITALS: BP 118/74, HR 72, Temp 98.2F, RR 14.

PHYSICAL EXAM: Well-appearing, no pallor, no lymphadenopathy, heart and lungs normal.

ASSESSMENT: Iron deficiency anemia.

PLAN: Start iron supplementation, recheck CBC in 6 weeks, follow up after labs.
